item.title: Pentagon Announces Seventh U.S. Death in War With Iran
item.summary: The service member killed was not publicly identified, but U.S. Central Command said the death was caused by injuries after an attack on a Saudi military base.

item.title: U.S. Continues Airstrikes Against a Wide Array of Targets in Iran
item.summary: A senior U.S. military official said those targets included missile launchers and air-defense sites.

item.title: Lebanese Villagers Bury Hezbollah Fighters, Praising Their Defiance of Israel
item.summary: After a fierce ground fight between Israeli forces and Iran-backed Hezbollah, the village of Nabi Sheet mourned its dead. “We are not here to bow,” said one villager. “We will not kneel.”

item.title: West Bank Violence Intensifies, as Israeli Settlers Kill 3 Palestinians
item.summary: A rise in settler attacks is terrorizing Palestinians in the occupied territory, at a time when global attention is focused on the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: Israel Strikes Energy Infrastructure Crucial to Iran’s Well-Being
item.summary: Continued attacks could make the Iranian government and the country as a whole more vulnerable.

item.title: Israeli Strikes on Fuel Depots Send Black Clouds Over Iranian Capital
item.summary: Immense dark plumes of smoke enveloped Tehran after the Israeli military expanded attacks on energy infrastructure.

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Baghdad Targeted as Iraq Gets Drawn Deeper Into Regional War
item.summary: Iraq is caught between two allies as the Trump administration pressures Iraqi leaders to distance themselves from Iran.

item.title: Vital Water Desalination Plants in Iran and Bahrain Are Attacked
item.summary: Strikes on nonmilitary infrastructure were a “serious escalation,” analysts said, and could widen the war’s impact on civilians.

item.title: A Loose Band of Emerging Powers Is Divided Over Iran
item.summary: Brazil, China and Russia all denounced the U.S.-Israeli attacks, but other nations in the BRICS group haven’t, even though Iran is a fellow member.

item.title: Iran Could Retrieve Uranium at Site U.S. Bombed Last Year, Officials Say
item.summary: The fate of the highly enriched uranium and the options for securing it have become critical issues for the Trump administration.
